title: Filipino-Style Ginataang Bilo-Bilo
description: A traditional Filipino dessert made with sweetened tapioca pearls, coconut milk, and glutinous rice balls. This version is a refreshing take on the classic, perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Combine glutinous rice flour and water in a bowl. Knead until a dough forms.
Divide dough into small balls and cook in boiling water until they float.
Combine coconut milk, sugar, and pandan extract in a saucepan. Heat over medium heat until sugar dissolves.
Add tapioca pearls to the coconut milk mixture and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cooked glutinous rice balls to the coconut milk mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
